subject: Error in lavaan 0.5-16 for multiple-group model with categorical data

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Error in lavaan 0.5-16 for multiple-group model with categorical data
parts:
Yves,

I ran into the following error when running a multi-group model with categorical data in the development version of lavaan:

library(lavaan)
myData <- read.table("http://www.statmodel.com/usersguide/chap5/ex5.16.dat")
names(myData) <- c("u1","u2","u3","u4","u5","u6","x1","x2","x3","g")
model <- '
f1 =~ u1 + u2 + u3
f2 =~ u4 + u5 + u6
'

fit <- cfa(model, data = myData, ordered = paste0("u", 1:6), group = "g")

Error in unlist(GW) : object 'GW' not found


The error does not appear when I remove the "group" argument. 

Thanks for your attention,

Terry
